### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索相关 issue，未发现相同的导航垂直位置问题。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

现象：Digital Mate APP 底部有“对话”和“发现”两个导航按钮。点击切换页面后，两项按钮整体的上下位置发生变化，不能保持在相同的屏幕位置，产生跳动感。

复现步骤：
1. 在手机中打开 Digital Mate，收起输入键盘。
2. 进入“对话”页，观察底部两个导航按钮的图标和文字位置。
3. 点击“发现”，观察相同导航按钮的位置。
4. 再切回“对话”，重复对比。

实际结果：两个页面的导航按钮垂直位置不一致。
预期结果：同一设备、相同屏幕方向且键盘收起时，两页导航按钮的图标、文字及点击区域位置一致；安全区和“内容由 AI 生成”文案不应造成按钮跳动。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：Digital Mate 鸿蒙手机端。
- 页面：对话页 DigitalMateHome、发现页 A2uiHome。
- 用户反馈：在同一手机切换两页即可观察到。
- 具体设备型号、系统版本及受影响安装包版本：待报告人核对。

### Additional Information

代码核对发现：DigitalMateHome 使用 compact=true 的 48 vp 导航行，并在其下显示 16 vp 的 AI 说明及页面自身底部留白；A2uiHome 使用默认 64 vp 导航行，由导航组件自行添加安全区留白。两者布局基准不统一。

涉及文件：
- digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/components/HomeBottomNav.ets
- digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets
- digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/Index.ets

修复 PR：https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/703（提交 37e576855463006b2ea0fbcaeb7101833a13188a，当前 open、未合入）。统一导航高度、底部留白和安全区；20 条相关测试通过，Debug 构建成功且已安装到真机。尚未提供切换前后对比截图或真机视觉验收结论。

### Version Information

受影响 APP 版本待核对；用户反馈于 2026-11-06（Asia/Shanghai）。
代码分析基于本地开发分支，不能据此断言所有已发布版本均受影响。

719.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已提供问题现象、环境、复现步骤及真机现场截图。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：手机端回答正文已完整显示，且下方已出现继续追问建议，但输入框右下角仍显示蓝色方块“停止”按钮，没有退出执行状态。

**复现步骤**：
1. 在 Digital Mate 手机端发起普通问答，例如比较打车与地铁的出行时间。
2. 等待回答正文、表格和继续追问建议显示完整。
3. 观察输入框右下角按钮，仍停留在停止图标。

**实际结果**：回答展示完成后，按钮仍表示任务正在执行，用户难以判断本轮是否结束。

**预期结果**：当前消息完成并且本地文字展示结束后，输入框退出停止状态；空输入恢复待输入/语音入口，输入文字后显示发送按钮。等待回执、回执待确认和文字仍在展示时继续允许停止，不误停止其他消息或后台任务。

**代码分析**：`hasComposerStop()` 读取普通的 inFlight/outgoing 对象及运行时任务对象，缺少对响应式可停止任务列表、发送/回执状态的依赖，ArkUI 在任务结束后可能不重新计算按钮分支。修复让按钮显式依赖页面 @State 状态，保持取消目标仍按本次 submission 绑定。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 客户端：Digital Mate / Beebou，HarmonyOS 真机（ICL-AL10）。
- APP：v0.1.8（10027）调试版；系统具体版本未采集。
- 云侧连接：`wss://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20010/digitalmate/ws`。
- 现场：用户手动真机验证；截图显示时间 23:54。

### Additional Information

- 与 #241（运行中停止图标点击无响应）不同，本问题关注回答完成后的按钮状态刷新。
- 与 Word 支持 PR #717 分开处理，不包含 DOCX 解析、原件缓存或追问语言修复。
- 已准备独立端侧修复；相关 Node 回归 62 个通过，Debug 构建成功。手机调试包已叠加该修复并安装，最终交互待用户再次手动验收。

### Version Information

- App 版本：v0.1.8（10027），Debug。
- 独立修复基于 main：75e770f4。
- 修复提交：a796bd8a。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![回答与追问建议已显示，输入框仍显示停止按钮](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd4afd95-93bf-4375-9317-64b6a371e4af)

721.author: hlXia-mm
721.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已提供真机复现步骤、环境信息及取消前后截图。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：点击回答下方的继续追问建议后，建议问题自动填入输入框，输入框上方出现“引用回答”栏。点击该栏右侧“取消”，引用栏消失，但自动填入的追问文字仍留在输入框中。

**复现步骤**：
1. 完成一次问答，等待出现继续追问建议。
2. 点击追问建议，例如“把这篇中秋文章压缩成300字左右的摘要”。
3. 不修改自动填入的文字，点击“引用回答”栏的“取消”。
4. 观察输入框，原追问草稿仍然存在。

**实际结果**：只取消引用，没有撤回此次追问自动填入的草稿，容易误发送已取消的问题。

**预期结果**：
- 未编辑的建议草稿随取消一起清除，输入框恢复空状态，并同步草稿存储，离开再返回不应恢复已取消文字。
- 如果用户已手动改写草稿，取消引用应保留编辑后的文字，避免误删用户内容。
- 普通手动“引用回答”后输入的文字不应因取消引用而被清空；未发送任何任务。

**代码确认**：`chooseSuggestion()` 同时设置 draft 和 replySelection；“取消引用回答”的点击回调仅将 replySelection 设为 undefined，未清理对应自动草稿。问题属于端侧状态管理。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Digital Mate / Beebou，HarmonyOS 真机 ICL-AL10；系统具体版本未采集。
- APP v0.1.8（10027）Debug。
- 云侧：`wss://onlineswarm.openjiuwen.com:20010/digitalmate/ws`。
- 用户手动真机验证，截图时间 00:44（2026-11-07，Asia/Shanghai）。

### Additional Information

- 与 #719 / PR #720（回答完成后停止按钮不恢复）分开处理。
- 与 PR #717 的 Word 解析、附件缓存功能，以及追问建议语言不一致问题无关。
- 修复范围：仅端侧识别建议自动草稿的来源、取消行为及对应回归测试，云侧不变。

### Version Information

- v0.1.8（10027），调试版。
- 复现时手机包含 Word 支持及按钮状态修复；本问题仍可独立复现。

### Screenshots / Recordings

图1：点击追问后自动填入草稿，显示引用栏及“取消”。

![取消前：追问草稿与引用栏](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e33cacc5-f216-48c3-b391-162283f3a8e9)

图2：点击取消后引用栏消失，但自动追问文字仍然存在。

![取消后：自动追问草稿未清除](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/84d67e03-97b4-4e1a-bad7-aca9a36d1786)

724.author: haowenz001
724.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索仓库内相关 issue，未找到同一问题（相近 issue 已在正文注明区别）。
- [x] 已提供群内原始反馈与截图。
- [x] 已按群公告的「现象 / 预期 / 场景」惯例整理（本次为群内对话+截图，非三段式原文）。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：问「附近有啥餐馆」，助手把用户的「当前位置」判定成松江九亭，据此算距离并给出门店清单；用户实际在虹桥，整份结果都建立在错误的位置上，且回答里没有提示这个位置是推测的、也没有确认。

群内原始反馈（2026-11-06 22:18，未央，附截图）：

> 问了下附近有啥餐馆
> 定位都错了哎

同群对话（夏华梁：「你不关注这个位置 是吧😅」；未央：「对的」「我在虹桥哈哈」「这定的哪里😅」）。

同群同学给出的根因判断（姜成林，2026-11-06 23:13）：

> 要定位是要获取用户权限的

截图里助手的原话（把推断位置当成了既定事实）：

> 距离是按你当前位置（松江九亭镇新寅路/小寅社区，上海松江高科技园区一带）算的直线距离；馆子名称、菜系和位置来自 OpenStreetMap 地图标注。地图数据里没有评分，所以"哪家最好吃"我没法用点评分数替你排，以上是就近、可实地去的门店清单。

复现步骤：
1. 在未授权定位的设备上提问「附近有啥餐馆」这类位置依赖问题。
2. 查看回答里的「当前位置」与实际位置是否一致。

实际结果：助手报出一个与用户实际位置不符的地址（松江九亭），并把按该地址算出的距离/门店当作「就近」结果给出，语气是确定的。
预期结果：
- 没有位置上下文或未获定位授权时，不要臆造「你当前位置」；应明确说「我拿不到你的位置」，并给出获取方式（申请定位权限 / 让用户说城市或地标）。
- 若使用 IP 或其他间接来源推断位置，必须标注「这是根据网络推断的大致位置，可能不准，可修改」。
- 位置依赖的结果（距离、就近排序）在位置不确定时不应展示具体距离数字，避免用户误信。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate / BeeBou 手机端
- 版本：报告人未标注；同日晚间另一位同学提交的反馈场景版本为 v0.1.7
- 系统：HarmonyOS
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群，2026-11-06 22:18–23:13（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 与 #573（位置依赖查询从不触发定位权限请求、客户端无定位能力、永远回退手动选城市）相关但不同：#573 描述的是「缺能力 → 弹城市选择卡」，#205 描述的是「有权限但 agent 不用」；本条的现场表现是**第三种**——既没有权限、也没有回退询问，而是直接给了一个错误的「当前位置」并据此产出结果。三者可分别修复，本条重点在「位置不确定时必须显式声明，不得当作事实」。
- 回答里还顺带出现了地图数据来源说明（OpenStreetMap），这部分表述是好的；缺的是位置来源的说明。

### Version Information

- App 版本：未标注（同批反馈为 v0.1.7）
- 反馈时间：2026-11-06 22:18（Asia/Shanghai）

### Screenshots / Recordings

![「附近餐馆」把当前位置判成松江九亭并据此给出距离](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261106/20261106_2218_wrong_current_location.jpg?raw=true)

### Context

来源：11月走查-记录.xlsx → 11月走查 → 第55行。页面：设置。

<!-- DM31:FINAL-OBJECTIVES-AND-ACCEPTANCE -->
#### Final objectives, acceptance criteria and benefit reporting (confirmed 2026-11-09)

<!-- DM31:ACCEPTANCE-ENVIRONMENT:20261117 -->
**Acceptance environment (2026-11-17 maintainer clarification).** When a work package requires end-to-end deployment or client acceptance, deploy the exact candidate to an authorized test environment and run the applicable scenarios on the emulator using the original client/unchanged HAP where required. Validate the real default assembly, startup, Gateway/owner paths, persistence, compatibility and rollback there as applicable. References to production assembly mean the actual supported deployment path and configuration exercised in the test environment. Deploying into the production environment, moving the production alias, and switching live user traffic belong to separate release operations and are not conditions for closing this refactor. All other applicable acceptance assertions, CI, independent QA, A/B and repeat requirements, hard dependencies, and the original 103-work-package closeout accounting remain in force. If deployment/emulator is the only remaining acceptance item, run and record it in the test environment and close the work package once its actual remaining assertions pass.

**Overall objective:** Preserve supported functionality, client compatibility and data semantics while migrating the server to components with clear responsibilities, a single writer for each authoritative state domain, and collaboration through public contracts. Complete source-directory and documentation-governance convergence, make common feature changes and component substitutions local in scope, and demonstrate through actual execution that critical paths have no significant performance regression.

This section consolidates maintainer-confirmed final deliverables and reporting requirements for this master tracker and Q11 #828. **Accepted requirements do not establish completed implementation or verification.** The existing frozen baselines, supported scope, contracts, client acceptance and stricter gates below remain binding. This section authorizes no new product semantics, relaxes no existing gate, reopens no accepted task, and does not accumulate all final acceptance under a single foundation component such as A02. Each child task closes against its original, explicit deliverable boundary; its owning task retains any outstanding final integration obligation, summarized here.

**1. Required deliverables and evidence-based acceptance**

| Objective | Observable acceptance criteria | Primary evidence and ownership |
|---|---|---|
| Clear component responsibilities and dependency boundaries, independently verifiable and replaceable through contracts | Components in migration scope have named owners, public interfaces and declared acyclic dependencies. Each authoritative state domain has one writer. Cross-component calls use public proxies, without accessing another component's private objects or authoritative tables. The actual default production entry reaches the new owner; migrated capabilities have no duplicate authority, silent legacy-executor fallback or reconnectable bypass. Representative implementation substitutions use established extension interfaces without modifying callers' internal logic. Independent deployment of every component and zero dependencies are not required. | Ownership/interface inventory, real call and write traces, boundary counterexamples, substitution and component tests; existing architecture, component and G05/G10 gates apply. Transitional legacy deviations still require an owner, cleanup task and bounded exit condition; they do not establish final migration completion. |
| Remove duplicate responsibilities and retired execution paths; converge the source layout | Every affected old path has an explicit migrate, retain or retire disposition. Server layout converges on the accepted architecture-foundation target while preserving unrelated `digitalmate/` client code, business code and dependencies with pinned provenance. Entry points, builds, imports, tests and deployment use the correct paths. Deletions require reference, call-path and functional evidence. Do not remove functionality to meet a line-count target or mechanically copy an entire branch. | D01 #845 path dispositions, entry mapping, clean installation/build and execution verification; code measurements are reported separately under the rules below. |
| Bounded impact and verification cost for common changes | Compare 3–5 representative changes before and after migration, such as model/tool adaptation, implementation substitution and an internal component-rule change. Internal changes stay with their owner; adapter changes use the adapter and necessary registration without modifying unrelated core code. Genuine shared-contract changes still require owner coordination; there is no promise that every request changes only one component. Developers can locate owners, contracts, entries and verification commands from documentation. | For each case, record baseline/candidate implementations or a reproducible change exercise, affected components/owners/files, unrelated core changes, verification environment/steps/time and component-level testability. Directory counts alone do not establish development efficiency. |
| Preserve functionality, client compatibility and data semantics | Retain the original frozen-baseline, supported configuration/API, full default Harness and unchanged-HAP A/B acceptance obligations, including files/artifacts, history, answer/retry/continue/cancel and the other established capabilities. Preserve persisted records and identities. Simplified probes, fake owners and component tests cannot replace actual client acceptance. | Existing Q04–Q10, capability matrix, identical HAP/driver/assertions, real production participants and deployment evidence; retain original failures and disposition differences individually. |
| Explainable and traceable failure, cancellation and recovery behavior | Verify duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, concurrency, Stop and unknown-outcome handling under existing contracts. Execution authority cannot resume after Stop. Correlate requests with M/S/R, attempts/actual implementations, commits and outcomes to identify the responsible component. Prove only the accepted recovery and bounded history-retention scope, without extending it to automatic continuation after arbitrary crashes. | Normal and fault evidence through real owners/persistence, Q03 tracing, existing lifecycle/Store contracts and negative cases; identify controlled substitutes and their scope. |
| Reproducible delivery and authoritative contributor guidance | Trace source, dependencies, build configuration, images and actual installed/runtime identities; verify clean deployment and existing rollback boundaries. AGENTS.md contains stable principles and protocol entry points while retaining effective constraints. Documentation establishes authoritative sources, navigation, old-document dispositions and repaired links under `protocols/specs/adr/procedures/lessons/verification/updates`, distinguishing proposed, accepted, implemented and verified status. | Existing build/deployment and G05 verification, D02 #847, D03 #848 and D01 final reference reconciliation; historical evidence proves only its named revision and scope. |
| No significant critical-path performance regression | Measure server overhead under comparable environments and workloads, reporting actual end-to-end behavior separately. Meet existing stricter service objectives and deadlines. Freeze baselines, measurement methods and tolerances before the final comparison; do not infer performance from architecture or widen thresholds after observing failures. | Comparative report under the performance rules below, included in Q11's final verdict; no unmeasured claim of “no regression.” |

**2. Required factual benefit reporting, without promised improvement percentages**

- **Code reduction:** Fix start/end SHAs and the first-party production-code counting scope. Separately report (1) evidenced removal of duplicate, unreachable or retired code, (2) added contract, adapter and reliability code, and (3) net production-code change. Report changes outside the first two categories separately so totals reconcile. Moves, copying followed by deletion, and formatting-only changes do not count as deduplication benefits. Count tests, documentation, generated code and third-party code with pinned provenance separately. Supply the counting tool, configuration, exclusions and representative deletion evidence. No reduction of N lines or N% is promised; a net increase does not automatically fail acceptance.
- **Development cost:** For the representative cases above, report change impact, environment preparation, required verification steps and elapsed time. Distinguish human work, tool waiting and test execution, and state sample limitations. Do not directly translate agent concurrency, model differences or one exercise into developer-productivity gains. Report measured improvement, no improvement or trade-offs without promising a productivity percentage.
- **Performance:** Keep hardware/resource limits, data volume, concurrency, workload and warm-up strategy comparable for server measurements. Use fixed model/tool responses to isolate external variability. Cover applicable queuing/submission, history reads, cancellation acknowledgement and execution-scheduling overhead. Report p50/p95, applicable throughput under fixed-load and saturation conditions, peak memory, and success/error/timeout rates so dropped work cannot appear as a speed gain. Separately report real end-to-end time using the same client and scenarios, explicitly identifying model/network and other external effects instead of combining the two into one conclusion. Record sample counts, repetitions, variability, commands and raw results.
- **Performance tolerances for baseline calibration only:** Evaluation may start from “p95 latency and peak memory increase by no more than 10% relative to baseline; throughput remains at least 95% of baseline.” These are **candidate tolerances, not active gates, passing results or exemptions from existing stricter objectives**. First measure baseline noise and applicable service objectives. The responsible owner then specifies absolute deadlines, applicable metrics and final thresholds, freezes them, and runs the candidate comparison. Record and disposition every unmet condition. Test-scanning/CI speed improvements count only toward verification cost, not product runtime performance.

**3. Consistent acceptance and progress reporting**

1. Trace every conclusion through “requirement/objective → owner and task → exact baseline/candidate SHA → actual entry and participants → commands, environment, results and evidence → outstanding work/blocker and next responsible owner.” Label evidence as source, component, integration, deployment or unchanged-HAP scope; these scopes are not interchangeable. Retain initial failures and subsequent runs without overwriting history.
2. Keep `proposed / accepted / implemented / verified` distinct, and keep execution outcomes `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN / INVALID` distinct. Completed documentation, a merged PR, increased test counts, reachable infrastructure or a successfully built image does not automatically establish production migration or client acceptance.
3. Close child tasks against their original acceptance criteria and backfill post-merge evidence, residual work and downstream dependencies. Do not expand a foundation package merely to close the master tracker. Report overall task counts, source integration, deployment and client acceptance separately. Without new formally tracked tasks, this section changes no denominator and manufactures no completion count.
4. The final #737 / Q11 #828 report consolidates the required deliverables, measured benefits and unresolved differences above. No minimum positive reduction in net code, development effort or additional runtime cost is promised, but the corresponding measurements and reproducible reports are required. Outstanding unrun, invalid or blocked mandatory acceptance prevents an unconditional refactor-completion claim. Existing difference-disposition and authorization rules continue to apply; retain visible limitations and their scope.

This section consolidates the existing Test Verification / Definition of done and D01–D03 requirements, adding reproducible benefit and performance reporting. The original detailed acceptance text remains below.
<!-- /DM31:FINAL-OBJECTIVES-AND-ACCEPTANCE -->

<!-- DM31:IMPLEMENTATION-HANDOFF -->

**Implementation entry point:** start with the [current developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/docs/developer_guide/README.md), [protocol reading guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/docs/protocols/README.md) and [migration development procedure](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/c19f1370542946bd67f87ded6ff010c1a3607afd/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md). The [original English implementation handoff](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/7463df78970323b7de7cbf4978f9312d947d9a57/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/implementation-handoff.md) is preserved as an immutable planning archive; current contributor rules come from the guides above. The assigned implementation agent should follow the current guides’ contract-first workflow: verify and merge contracts and gates, prove compliance through a real consumer PR, then expand dependent development. Isolate genuine blockers in issues and continue eligible work without requesting routine maintainer decisions. This is the subsequent implementation phase; the original survey remains planning evidence, not an implementation pass.

**11/17 17:18 CST 交接。** #1720 #1690 #1688 #1687 #1691 #1772 #1719 #1685 #1699 #1763 #1700 共11个 Draft 已 CLOSED/unmerged，原分支、head和回执保留。原验收包、依赖与门禁保持；非草稿 #1279→#1260→#1261→#1257 未动。

**2026-11-17 17:45 CST 四个非草稿接收。** 本轮只恢复非草稿 [#1279](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1279) → [#1260](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1260) → [#1261](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1261) → [#1257](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1257)，顺序不变。公开 #1279 `34710b3f5b382e1346fb53fcb3303c70722391ed` 仍 OPEN/CONFLICTING、#1260/#1257 CONFLICTING；#1261 可合并但排在前置之后。 私有接收 `86c254cd357db4f1c48293dacbd461819b6763a6`（tree `534b2e7401f401aed56b4e32a33ca63519c49c8a`）用实际冻结 main `2a78369532a3219b7b72f8fc5b9ddb25e0c7f6c1` 与原 `bc7a634f7fff2639d4ce29a0eef71280d7c6ab7b`，手工解决 Dockerignore 和 A01 build-context 测试两处冲突。未发布，HK与独审进行中，当期公开候选/CI尚未验证，无新增共享资源授权。 #1275 原忙路径先启动及私有文件副作用仍 FAIL，进程退出后存活后代与 SQLite 重新取权的 UNKNOWN 仍 P1。四 PR 和原验收均开放。

[#1605 实际498 repo-size](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43820103337) 实际 `498bc351` GitHub 可用范围仅 repo-size PASS。[#1670 的1e194a86直连设备回执](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1670#issuecomment-6912584884) 是 test-0 直连的附件切片 PASS。 旧 G5/G6 留各自候选、HAP 和场景范围。上述回执无当前 #1279 合成树、test-3 或生产验收。

### Proposed Solution

**Architecture:** Message/Session/Run are core identities. The trusted Home ingress targets Beebou and its Harness proposes Bee selection under the accepted Hive contracts; Agent Service validates the target and Session Manager owns admission/recovery; SQLite Store owns authoritative DM records; backend owns execution coordination/controls/final publication; Harness owns loop policy; Runtime owns same-process Python assembly/readiness/lifecycle. Every parent/child/summary/compression/vision/skill model/tool/context effect follows HostAPI. Public proxies mediate cross-component operations. Exact Registry factories bind sessions; replacement works without installed default Core. Room is a compatibility projection. Artifact bytes survive execution workspace release. Gateways dispatch/normalize evidence, host hooks own application policy, BudgetProvider alone owns balances, Store owns attempt/turn accounting. Stop permanently closes execution authority; late accounting cannot reopen it or change terminal outcome.

**Main reuse strategy:** retain the pinned normal DeepAgent/task-loop/ReAct algorithms, prompt attachment logic, default general-purpose children and six controls, six office skills, pure file/image/office validation and provider business leaves. In the original pre-Hive baseline, both ordinary/simple modes selected `agent.work.normal`; reconcile the current Hive bindings explicitly and do not mistake simple heuristics for a current model-only path. Team is off by default but supported explicit configuration must have a migration path. Rehome model/tool dispatch, SDK checkpoint/history, child persistence, compaction inference, vision reads and skill process I/O to their host/provider owners. Do not retain WorkSwarm supervisor, Session DB, EngineService or DeepAdapter global bootstrap as a second execution authority. Existing UI and wire consumers remain the comparison target.

**Critical paths:** identity/contracts → Store admission/context → Manager/Registry/Host/backend → Runtime/Hive + bound Beebou/Bee factory/model/tool adapters → G07/Q03 → unchanged CHAT-01/02. Checkpoint and same-S decisions run early and gate only their dependent adapter/persistence/control activation. Full acceptance additionally requires child/deep I/O, supported conditional business paths, production accounting/inspect, format/old-writer guard, A/B corpus and independent verdict. A compatible format guard blocks new-format traffic, not unrelated extraction work.

**共享修改串行点。** Store schema/codec/事务一个 owner；Host 生命周期一个 owner；Runtime/Bridge 装配一个集成 owner；架构 registry、公共类型及包映射先由生产者审阅合入。各业务 owner 可并行做窄切片，禁止多人整块重写 server.py 或搬整个 temp/hive-runtime。迁移每个分区时同步 caller、测试、打包、登记和模块文档，验收后删除该分区旧 adapter/force-include/registration。

#### 12 月 7 日架构政策退出关口

在 `498bc351`，[docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json) 有 **242 个 legacy_inventory 模块、87 个 components、0 exceptions，expires=2026-12-07**。[tools/architecture/check.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/tools/architecture/check.py) 在 UTC 日期超过 expiry 且清单非空时报告 AR10，domains 检查同样检查日期。本计划按到期前收口，不能利用日期比较边界拖延。该期限独立于 #963 原 11/22 全交付目标，不能把后者静默延期。

- **11/17 18:00 CST，W0 清单/合同冻结目标。** D01 将 242 模块逐行映射到上述十包、当前/目标 owner、实际 caller/writer、保留/迁移/退役、验收和 ETA。D03 首批修正当前文档入口，接口未获评审的写 proposal。原 #737 任务/硬边、计划分支生成输入一并对齐，旧 render 不得覆盖本轮。
- **11/18–11/22，W1 第一波实现目标。** 优先真实默认入口、Manager/Store、Host/Plugin Gateway 和可独立落地的兼容门面。#1279 只接一次切流后基线并独审精确验证，再按 #1260→#1261→#1257。先核对 #1605 实际 main 受影响复验回执，缺失则补在后续执行计划，不能把分支 G5/G6 移标 main。本轮无新运行。
- **11/23–11/29，W2 领域切片目标。** Source/Artifact/Office、连接器、Memory、调度各按原依赖集成，逐模块转入可执行 enforcement 或有证据退役。边界不清的大模块先按内部职责拆，禁止仅改 checked 标志或搬目录以消除清单。
- **11/30–12/04，W3 清零目标。** 默认装配、安装/来源、反旁路、reader/writer、目录与文档联合验收，legacy_inventory 清零；未完成项逐项 owner/ETA，不能用通配豁免替换。
- **12/05–12/06，缓冲。** 政策与实际 main 独立复核，留失败修复/安装证明容量。12/07 保留为现行硬退出日期。若 11/22 或其后检查点证明容量不足，立即公布风险与实际剩余项；任何延期需逐 owner/任务的明确评审，当前不批准延长。

W0–W3 是新的架构工作目标，尚无具名容量承诺或实测总工时，**AT_RISK，最终完成 ETA UNKNOWN**。完整 #737 收尾还需原产品/生产/性能/独立 QA，legacy 清零不代表整体完成。

#### 证据、进度和后续会话规则

每个切片记录基线/候选/实际 merge SHA、真实 caller/状态 writer、允许依赖、精确门禁与 artifact、镜像/config/HAP、实际参与者/替身、失败/未运行、原 Issue 剩余义务。旧证据仅在逐项证明输入等价时复用，身份不改。#1636 分套件预算按实际启用规则使用，#1656 上传容错不免除可回读证据。#1605 的 admin/base-policy 自举记录只适用于该合入，后续正常 producer-first/CI/独审规则不变。

#1316 报告 Hive G5 13 PASS/0 FAIL/1 BLOCKED/3 NOT_RUN，G6 5 PASS/0 FAIL/3 BLOCKED/1 NOT_RUN，并记录延期/已知限制；这是切流范围的接受，不给 #737 原 87 个开放包补发通过。本次不运行测试、CI、部署、设备，也不改代码或工程文档。下一实现批必须把源码、组件边界与 docs/implementations/modules 同步收敛。

#### Work-package detail and previous tracker versions

Issue links in the four cutover groups are the current package register. The
[original package tree](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737/sub_issues)
retains the underlying work packages and native dependencies. Delivery details
remain with the package owners and [milestone tracker #963](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/963).
The [class migration checklist](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/implementations/migration/class-migration-checklist.md)
and [architecture](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/architecture/README.md)
retain the detailed source map. The earlier long-form tracker is available in
this issue's edit history.

### Test Verification

**Two independent release gates:**

1. **Architecture and production assembly:** AR01–AR10 static import/export/dependency/cycle/private-access/DB-domain/Harness-I/O/legacy-executor/install-origin rules plus legal and violating fixtures. Runtime ST from actual default public entry verifies Router→AS→HostAPI→Store, authenticated scope, exact versions/selection, Stop fences, physically Core-free replacement and dispatch exclusively at provider boundaries. Deliberate bypass mutants must fail. Real owners/SQLite are not replaced by fakes when asserting ownership.
2. **Frozen-main behavior:** same HAP hash, driver SHA, case/assertion versions and comparable data; only backend identity changes. Capture old/new source/image/build/configuration and run IDs. Each new pass traces phone M→new S/R→Host call→authoritative record. CHAT-01/02 first; then all frozen-main scenarios (36 manifest entries, including supplemental disposition) and supported API/configuration behaviors, not only historical 23 E2E. File/Office/image/history/reference/interaction/cancel/supplement/reconnect/restart are explicit groups. PPT must contain actual requested title/file, remain readable after workspace release, and open from the original phone. Official historical 7c build and alternative compilation evidence stay separate.

Retain PASS, FAIL, environment-BLOCKED and NOT-RUN separately; also preserve validator INVALID where applicable. Old failures are not hidden or waived by a new pass. Real-provider, component, phone and deployed-image results have distinct scope. Every batch reruns impacted cross-component tests on the integrated head. Independent QA does not approve its own implementation.

**Early counterexample gates:** #712 before-admission metadata validation and known pre-execution failure classification are independently corrected candidate findings, still require main regression. #723 is bounded same-S feasibility only. Real pre-R authentication scope/BGE attempts, physical retry identity, null/missing versus zero, true pre-completion reply deltas, atomic budget reserve/settle, unknown liability, post-Stop settlement and production outcome/accounting inspect all receive explicit tasks. TEST-ONLY writers, parent-only proxy injection and minimal Core examples cannot satisfy these gates.

**CI reuse and enforcement:** retain Node/Hypium/ArkTS and existing `pr-ready`; reuse credential-free server regression selection and case assertions. New Python architecture/server suites are not already covered by them. Missing/skipped/cancelled/zero-case mandatory suites fail the new aggregate. Trusted base owns policy/scanner configuration; rule changes require trusted review and candidate self-tests. Historical survey access reported branch protection disabled, CODEOWNERS absent and ruleset reads403; these are frozen planning observations, not current administration proof. The latest [G09 acceptance readback](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745#issuecomment-6709027699) records branch-protection access404/unavailable, which does not establish that no rules exist. G10 still requires administrator activation/readback and a negative merge test before enforcement may be claimed.

**Evidence-pending / not separately published:** no new main Bug/UX finding has sufficient standalone reproduced visual evidence in this survey. Existing bugs remain linked. Candidate-only gaps are migration regression requirements, not relabeled main incidents. Any later main defect without screenshot/recording remains in this register until the Bug template can be satisfied; nothing is silently deleted.

**Definition of done:** closing every child is necessary but insufficient. Independent full architecture/production-assembly verdict, complete frozen-main comparison with accepted dispositions, supported conditional paths, pinned build provenance and compatibility/rollback/old-writer checks must pass. No code implementation, feature parity or deployment is claimed by publishing this plan.

<!-- DM31:GOVERNANCE-FINAL-ACCEPTANCE -->

**Final governance acceptance** also requires actual directory convergence with exhaustive source disposition and no stale supported entry/import/build/deploy/test references; merged stable AGENTS guidance with the original mandatory repository rules preserved; and substantive documentation authority/navigation, complete original-file disposition, repaired moved links, and status/evidence consistent with actual main. D02/D03 initial developer guidance proceeds now. Final D01 runtime and D03 affected-reference reconciliation remain tracked until verified. These requirements are native blockers on Q11 and retain all production/behavior gates above.

### 🚀 Background Description

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A01`.

**Outcome:** One authority-derived scope, submission/session/run/revision identity and rejected/failed/unknown/terminal semantics.

**Owner:** Agent Service contract owner. **Batch:** P0: contracts, inventory and early gates. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve One authority-derived scope, submission/session/run/revision identity and rejected/failed/unknown/terminal semantics, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py::Message; Run; Task` into `server/agent_service/contracts.py; server/router/contracts.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/contracts.py; server/router/contracts.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_workspace.py) — `Message; Run; Task`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/contracts.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/contracts.py) — `RunScope`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/router/ingress.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/router/ingress.py) — `SubmitRequest`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/protocols/boundaries.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/protocols/boundaries.md) — `ownership table`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Existing mobile submission correlation
- Immutable caller intent distinct from server-selected output

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Owner strings treated as credentials
- Private objects crossing components

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/contracts.py
- server/router/contracts.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a01.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**

- Status-only gate described as merge protection

**Writable boundary:**

Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Blocks:** [DM31-Q11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/828)

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Readback:** gh api repos/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/branches/main; administrator retrieves effective protection/rules/check sources and demonstrates blocked negative/correct positive PR under authorized settings.

- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

A09 **OPEN**。`git ls-tree` 的 tracked 路径在 `498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4`→`629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 为 `server/` **31→31**、`temp/` **332→375**。同区间 `server/` 仅 `agent_service/session_store/proxy.py` 修改；`temp/` 有 43 新增、66 修改、零删除。 该计数包含源码、测试和文档。 现行 Dockerfile 声明安装 Root Contracts、私有 History 与 Bridge `[geo]`；Bridge wheel 源声明 12 个来自 `temp/` 的 `force-include` 映射。默认启动链是 Docker entrypoint → `engine_cli serve` → `configured_bridge`，Bridge 装配 `EngineService(legacy_execution=False)` 与 `HiveTurnStartup`。 HK 局部 installed origins 只归其各自范围。[实际 Dockerfile](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e/harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile#L53-L54)、[entrypoint](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e/harness/personal-agent/deploy/entrypoint.py#L29)、[实际 CLI 调用](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_cli.py#L213)、[Bridge 装配](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/server.py#L494-L499)、[Bridge wheel 映射](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/pyproject.toml#L73-L88)、[#768](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/768)。 新 Runtime owner 的 `server/runtime.py` 与 `server/__main__.py` 尚无实际默认调用。 各切片要求真实默认 caller 使用承接 owner，wheel/包映射及启动入口一致，适用授权测试环境和原门禁各有精确证据。查明获权消费者已迁移后才退旧 adapter/manifest。当前四个优先项的已验收 owner 转移为 **0**。 [#821](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/821)。

**Runtime 云启动源接收，仍待包门禁。** 在实际 `629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 上的本机 `3bed4d38136b260fe2dcbffb9148993d967389a2` 仅三路径。原 Docker entry script 的设置工作在候选内转交给 Runtime `server.deploy.cloud.main`，保留同一 `engine_cli serve` 进程入口。四组脚本 A/B 环境与参数相同，实际 `execv` 用受控接收器核验同 PID/信号；CLI 8/8、部署设置 14/14，独审源码无 P1/P2。[实际 entrypoint](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e/harness/personal-agent/deploy/entrypoint.py#L29)。 现行可信架构保留新增两叶 AR10；A01 原检查在候选 3/4，Python 数 30→32，Root wheel 管理输入 31→33。现行 Docker context 两个新文件都未纳入；实际 INCOMING 与 #1690 CURRENT 现有 31 项合同各拒该新增库存。原 Root 缺 `server.deploy` 时脚本拒绝启动。 源验证使用私有导入根；正常接收需要现行 owner/policy、字面 Docker 路径、受审包输入、安装/启动及授权 TEST。无真实镜像或 TEST 回执，#756/#758 前置仍 OPEN。源码/包回执 SHA-256 `e84caea733e75c003586bde7de3d952259e4fe592992490076dbf39f27546f09`、`cbd1867a3096e09f23b5e29a77bfee4a0d1ea94c4b2ee1f3ad5ed9d6db3466ae`。

**Runtime Root 隔离安装回执。** 同一本机 `3bed4d38136b260fe2dcbffb9148993d967389a2`（父实际 `629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e`）在自有 HK Linux x86_64、UID 2110、CPython 3.13.13 按锁定 Hatch 构建真实 Root wheel。33 项源码 payload、37 项 wheel、40 项 clean site 的 RECORD/字节及 32 个 installed import origins 核对通过；checkout 已移除，无 `PYTHONPATH`，Root-only `pip check` **PASS**。 旧入口与新 shim 启动此已安装 owner 的默认和 legacy env 四次走真实 `execv`，受控 receiver 对照相同 argv/环境、同 PID 与 SIGTERM -15。独审通过；Engine/Hive 未启动，私有根已回收。此前两个 31 项可信合同仍拒新增输入，实际 Docker context 0/2。Docker/native/test deployment/collector 与原 HAP 未运行，实际接收和原前置保持。回执 `502086fa4a0b3f774918e63971e7079b1349efc36bf5790ea73b593d8feec1e9`、wheel SHA-256 `9dc4a68ad6479f3b1ff0f62a3f30911c0422a702d39e6ed672c2a98ba0d62a7a`。

**现有 #758 前置实测。** 实际 `629ba37e` 的 UTC clock allowlist 可配置，PreparedProfile 两侧仍为空，同一 exact tool 解析均 `MissingDependency`。Runtime/Registry 与原 Host owner 的 binding/attempt/Stop 接收待验，#753 完成和原原生边保持。[#758](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758)。

**Runtime Root33 私有接收准备。** 在 `318ff156db83675313289e3241e1b78935dbceed` 和实际 `09489ca8a3b52ecd68da9076cee08bb1e8bee9d1` 的相同受影响输入上，独审核对本机 `3bed4d38136b260fe2dcbffb9148993d967389a2` 后续三段。A09 填两条 `pendingSource`，只有 `server.deploy.cloud.main` 新公开操作；候选 Docker context 精确纳入两个叶，6 个诱饵与缺叶变异拒绝，源 A01 4/4。假设的严格 33 清单定向 4/4，有效 33 PASS、旧 31 拒绝；当前 INCOMING31 仍拒 33，现行源码旧 31 原通过保留。 [#1690](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1690) 冻结 CURRENT31 在自己的原范围留证，在实际注册表读 `history-recovery-sources` 得 `unreviewed-shape` FAIL。精确现行受保护全量/collector 取证仍需解决 [#1684](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1684) 的 capture、并以 [#1720](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1720) 或 owner 已审等效方案具备 History dependencies，随后按原普通 gate 核受信 31→33、实际安装和 TEST。Root19 历史授权留原批。三个私有阶段 SHA-256 `145514770a16f8efc2ed8fb215cc9e23a8e6788dc40923d9eed057e92e2c42d0`、`0d1d4987d7a37a245bd2778ad104e85293871ac73ac9bc083702d968e72d17d0`、`c1da3ae38b37b79fd8ce0efcda373233fb0d304f4a5be169852572fce30ee62b`；总回执 `713447247ea87945af8bfc84967f055d7a15a8d49c208637f34e5f273edafc48`。

**A09 readiness 策略源接收。** 实际 `09489ca8a3b52ecd68da9076cee08bb1e8bee9d1` 到本机 `83e5faf85461df4924fb188af438a167cc5f38c9`，现有真 `GET /health/ready` 向 Runtime `server.runtime` 传 startup 状态及四个原 owner 的延迟布尔读取，保留 JSON/status、liveness、pending 与 reader short-circuit，Bridge 保留原 HTTP 及授权。实际 18/18、本机 19/19，原树新用例 1/1 对照，eager 读取及忽略 effects 两变异均被拒。 独审 exact 通过，文档子提交 `a1602c87d4bde210d478eb8faf37c86df96079e5` 的三项执行字节相同。当前可信 AR10 拒一个 `server/runtime.py`，原 A01 Python 30≠31 FAIL，实际 Docker context 遗漏该叶；候选未安装或部署。独立于 3bed Root33，合并两切片只是假设 34 项。实际可信准入、Engine 默认路径、镜像/授权 TEST/HAP 与原前置待交。源码回执 SHA-256 `353fef71467cf15e781288d6b12bc11fa02f64731aed3f9dacf8f96a641df94c`。

**A09 早启动失败的 owner 交接。** 本机 `26a3b9ec29cb1a94cc0121362f048610b9c4d963`（tree `14fa11c103352266645319508b76c8bb0b63291b`）基于实际 `09489ca8a3b52ecd68da9076cee08bb1e8bee9d1`，四个既有路径。Runtime CLI 原直接访问子进程和 log，改经 WorkSwarmAdapter 的 `abandon_early_start()`，仍按原 group 回收后关闭 log。真实 SQLite 锁和受控 Popen 的 TERM/KILL 对照保持顺序；回收或 log 关闭抛错时保留原 startup 错误及 SQLite cause，仅加异常类型说明。未抛异常的 group false 或超时仍可能缺回报。 实际 66 PASS+4，候选 67 PASS+4，现行可信扫描 526/284/0，独审核对 no P1/P2。[#1275](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1275) 原零 Popen 断言仍 FAIL，与 #1279/#1289 重叠处接收前须保留同 loop Bridge stop。只读 e6 比对同路径，无新 e6 复验、安装、受保护执行或授权 TEST。回执 SHA-256 `0fa667e1c54ed3e3ae23d252a634bc7863c7a668856c611558d28b393fc9d6fe`。

**#1279 原接收语义组合。** 私有 `bc7a634f7fff2639d4ce29a0eef71280d7c6ab7b`（tree `92bc993cd191199bfba3cc5a639ba3d9f2ff1435`）是本机 `63e4e36352a6a9b9d79c1538e310ea4c2f32ec21` 的三路径独立子提交，CLI 的原 group 和 close 两个尝试归 WorkSwarmAdapter。group 抛错后仍尝试 log close，单独普通 close 抛错维持接收分支既有原行为，不额外加 note。这个分支与 A09 私有 26a3 的 log-close 语义分别验。 原同 loop Bridge.stop、MockMail、SQLite Workspace 保留。真实 Popen/SQLite 四组观察与 63e 一致，启动回归 7/7，独审无 P1/P2。`#1275` 零 Popen FAIL，未抛的 group false/timeout 仍无完成回执，保护全量/collector、安装、原生、授权 TEST 与公开接收顺序保持。回执 SHA-256 `a398e580508127a45d5c8f28cd92475d2b429f85254a1d8c4381ef6aaadeb2bb`。

**#1275 Workspace 时序原型，独审 P1/BLOCKED。** 实际 `e6cf4d8d` 与私有 `bc7a634f` 在忙且原 SQLite 锁保持时仍一 Popen 并写 dotenv/log。私有同 B 一次交接阻止忙路径启动、正常 fresh/migrated 通过，same-loop7、Hosted/Privacy20+13；五组受控 marker p50 早先取得锁+1.015ms，后置+314.078ms。 原型 UNKNOWN 在引用释放后失去租约，真实受控 descendant 仍活时已有新 SQLite owner，原 bc7 更早释放。源码接收、真实 WorkSwarm 性能及完整安装/TEST 尚待，原实际零启动 FAIL。[#1275](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1275)。回执 `32d6b81433da410e7bd2c20eabdd149e9bf0c51bd6d66cc14179747a47acfd40`。

**#1275 同步退出观察，P1 保持。** 私有 bc7 overlay `32db1bc3` 报告 leader/group 未确认，保持原信号与异常、独立关日志，12 A/B、旧4顺序和 same-loop7 通过，Windows 仅 shim。 独立实验的真实 CLI 退出 1 后，另一 SQLite 重新独占而受控旧组后代仍活。原 owner/部署/安装待验，零启动 FAIL、UNKNOWN P1 不变。[#1275](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1275)。回执 `ea8a38017a95ae09cf14bedef771e505b3b499141829f066fa51560920960c12`。

759.title: [Feature]: [DM31-A09] Assemble one Python Runtime through both component proxies

760.author: Jianyu010
760.body:
### Background and Goal Description

<!-- DM31:A10 -->
**2026-11-16 disposition — SUPERSEDED / NOT_PLANNED.** #1605 merged as `498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4`. #1313 retired Router and #1316 records the accepted Hive cutover. The old implementation plan to recreate `server/router`, continuity BGE/judge selection and a Router ten-second deadline is no longer planned. This closure does not claim original-scope implementation or verification and does not increase #737's completed count.

### Responsibility handoff

| Original obligation | Continuing owner / acceptance |
| --- | --- |
| Ordinary Home target and Bee selection | Existing Hive design #1228 / cutover #1313. New routing quality, continuation and queue/preempt behavior remains in #1665's product issues. No new implementation is assigned here. |
| Trusted target values, scope, revision, unknown admission and duplicate reconciliation | A01/A14 contracts plus A07 #755; A11 #812 validates configuration before admission; A12 #811 retains bound selection. Current values are in `server/agent_service/contracts.py`, not `server/router`. |
| Mobile and application callers | M02 #763 and A24 #794 use public Agent Service admission/control. Their native A10 prerequisite is replaced by A07 #755. |
| Policy and paid/pending admission | A11 #812 and A16 #815 replace their native A10 prerequisite with A07 #755. A12, A15 and A26 existing prerequisites remain. Actual caller budgets and pre-R applicability require explicit design, without inventing a Router. |
| Historical codec, read-only legacy history, no revived executor | G06 #769, A13 #813 and D01 #845 retain original compatibility/fence obligations. No old in-flight Router cross-version continuation. |

Current master plan #737 and milestone #963 record all four edge substitutions. The old A07/A31 incoming dependencies remain historical on this retired issue. Re-rendering old plan-branch artifacts must not restore this task or its outgoing edges; D03 #848 tracks reconciliation. No tests, CI, deployment or device jobs were run for this planning update.

### Historical design and receipts

The following original body is preserved for provenance. Its implementation paths, classifier algorithm and Router acceptance are superseded as above. Untransferred safety, data and permission guarantees remain with the named owners.

<details>
<summary>Original A10 proposal — historical, not an active implementation task</summary>

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A10 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A10`.

**Outcome:** Rule-first continuity, scoped BGE and ambiguous judge, distinct execution selection and one shared ten-second deadline.

**Owner:** Router owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

**与 Project Hive #1228 的边界：** 会话与执行 selection 继续归 #760（A10 / `server/router`）；#1223 的 Delivery 只向已指定的 Bot 投递，目标为 `temp/beebou/src/dm_beebou/delivery/` → `server/agent_service/delivery/`，由 #1226 的实施方接续。

**Hive 完全退场（H-D3，2026-11-13 已确认方向）：** 上述承接只适用于过渡期。普通 Home 将由可信入口定向到 Beebou，Bee 选择在 Beebou Harness 内完成。[#1313](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1313) 按 H-R1–H-R16 迁走全部真实调用方后删除旧选路与 `server/router`；其中 H-R15 要求在本 Issue 改定 A10 目标，把仍需的话题连续判断迁入 Beebou 候选决策，RoutingInput / RouteSelection / ExecutionPath 值契约交 A01/A14 与 Agent Service 提交 owner。该迁移的接口待签收，见 [#1228 决策登记](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#user-content-hive-decisions)。

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Rule-first continuity, scoped BGE and ambiguous judge, distinct execution selection and one shared ten-second deadline, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py::ConversationRouter.route` into `server/router/proxy.py; server/router/policy.py; server/router/gateway_classifier.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/router/proxy.py; server/router/policy.py; server/router/gateway_classifier.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py) — `ConversationRouter.route`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/router/proxy.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/router/proxy.py) — `RouterProxy.submit_routed, _route`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/router/proximity.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/router/proximity.py) — `ProximityClassifier`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/adr/0002-server-runtime.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/adr/0002-server-runtime.md) — `routing clarification`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Existing explicit/reply intent
- Scoped history
- Tool-free AgentCall
- Unknown admission semantics

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Old runtime routing authority
- Renewing deadlines on retries
- Timing out a potentially committed admission as unaccepted

**Writable boundary:**
- server/router/proxy.py
- server/router/policy.py
- server/router/gateway_classifier.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a10.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755), [DM31-A31](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/757)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763), [DM31-A24](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/794), [DM31-A11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/812), [DM31-A16](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/815)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/756), [DM31-A32](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758), [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-A21](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/761)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Do not silently restore greeting EPHEMERAL/capacity or pending-focus semantics

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Reconcile duplicate before fresh classification
- Timeout or swallowed cancellation prevents subsequent stages/admission
- Unavailable capabilities return a precise error rather than arbitrary fallback

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a10

**Cases:** - Delayed metadata/embedding and swallowed cancellation
- Shared stale-retry budget
- Slow committed receipt recovery
- Stable large/small finite vector ranking

**Participants:** Real Router/Manager/Store and default policy; captured main routing fixtures and controlled embedding/judge/path providers. A live classifier quality sample is separate, not implied.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.

**C1 当前权限复核，BLOCKED。** 实际 `629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 的 Host issuer 校验当前实例凭据、原 EngineStore 和 host ID，workspace/principal 在 bootstrap 另取。当前实际接入尚缺能在 pre-claim 一起绑定 active Host、原 EngineStore 和 Engine workspace/principal 的已接受 seam。 Routing 保持原单 writer、旧 DDL、记录早于独立 admission；与 #755 的 post-claim 权限证据分别验收。[#1719 `454b3107`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1719) 原政策草案不提供 issuer，旧 `f5795ffb`/P2 留原回执，[#1700 `88067701`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1700) routing DDL FAIL 保持。本轮只读核对，无新候选或运行门禁。回执 SHA-256 `c6b6ce14aa374a2a2a8b2cf9f7591ee90d665392ab54efd2213924a00585ab65`。

**C1 真 caller 本机接收，普通策略 BLOCKED。** 实际 `e6cf4d8d4fd27f4ab0e5f4ef5d066ce7b50b4ff8`、本机 `f29654d775773ee0c98c68f601a42d0e721872bc`（tree `f18472306cb9ccd497d762776d47dc9677f2984a`）组合独审 Host `1c5207ad7cd22e9bbc2353a22d02fe995e92496a` 与 Store，实际26 PASS、组合37 PASS，独审复跑4/4边界并核 37 原日志。真实 Bridge/WS/EngineStore/SQLite，模型和外部执行受控。 唯一 HiveStore 用同 `digitalmate.db`、同连接及事务，五条原 SQL 字节一致。原 Bridge 私有登记选同一真实 issuer，pre-claim read/record/discard 绑定 live Host+Store+workspace/principal，锁重试及锁内再验撤权，拒绝异域时无业务 SQL。UNKNOWN 可留原持久记录，当前请求不进行 admission/dispatch。#1757 Choice、原 DDL 时机与 admission 顺序保留。公开 #1753 的 `5e521542` 只做相关切面与 dry merge，测试仍归实际 e6。 现行可信 5 AR01/AR10，单加 [#1719 `454b3107`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1719) 的假设为3，完整私有登记反事实为0。原 Bridge private registrar 的 AR10 仍待普通 producer/consumer 接收，私有0不能作为原策略通过。历史 `f5795ffb`、`be526c40` 等缺口、[#1700 `88067701`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1700) 的 DDL FAIL 及其它原扫描发现保留。未执行 wheel/保护/collector/TEST，实际主线与旧 adapter 不变。回执 SHA-256 `dfe7963e05d0fa3caf83d0a6e6dcda709e8afca73be8fb1060fc8ee26aa9e377`。

**C1 独立 checker 前置。** [#1772 `b0393453d05d89fc4e33b00aa41aea34c6463778`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1772) OPEN Draft，实际 `660c45fae4c09d86c523e5de6e337b09c7aff1f9`、普通合成树 `1469e7417ae8a07789959fa1700522fa1960b3db`。原可信、旧 checker 对候选、新 checker 对候选三份 JSON 逐字相同 `094cb1da2f6d3351a6012224cf1dc382d463bd351203a3fa31aca0b42d530919`，527/285/11/0。独立核验五文件与十项 CLI，定向24项通过。只验证两树均无新叶时 exact private pendingSource 待料能力，此时零 import/constructor 授权；普通顺序仍为 checker、可信 owner/调用 metadata、实际产品源，[#1719](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1719) 未变。 实际与候选的三个原 Domain 测试仍逐字相同 **FAIL**，七项 AR03 为 Hive routing 1、HiveStore 5、Bee search 1。G03 #767 由 Jianyu010 协调 Session Store、Hive Backend/Host，另有 [#1728](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1728) huben0423-hw。公开检查仅 size SUCCESS／11 SKIPPED，C1 可信激活、完整 writer 签收、普通 CI/部署仍待。

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:G05 -->

<!-- DM31:A01-RETAINED-IMAGE-RUNTIME:1990 -->
**Current retained-image disposition — exact d04/f29, not later8b:** [Independent actual-image receipt](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759#issuecomment-6714325853) accepts Python3.13.16/UID10001, real installed11/root5/bridge281, all4077 required Core/WorkSwarm members plus1357 reviewed omissions, retrieval/build + `py.typed`, seven overrides,62/232 dependency inventories, two pip checks/strict output and the corrected Pod-physical-absence-before-ConfigMap cleanup. This closes the named actual installed-member gate via approved source/stage-map→filesystem/RECORD comparison, not a new whole-wheel archive/backend-process attestation. Exact source `d04d5002388561824f1e85838131f28025945073`, digest `sha256:f29f196d578c934d44efb455a691061991948a0267348e049e6f44d5dd172754`; no8b row-port/A02 image claim.

**Permanent history and residuals:** the prior300s Ready timeout/zero-command attempt and21:58 ConfigMap-before-physical-barrier late startup remain FAILED; current corrected cleanup does not retrospectively repair them. [851c complete-member proof remains withdrawn](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/883#issuecomment-6712530836); same-process/F2 limits remain. Core physically absent, independent Harness and clean fresh declared install remain OPEN under this issue and its original prerequisites/checklist; A09 actual Runtime composition remains OPEN. A02 Store/real reader, A13/Q04/Q11 provider/business deployment/unchanged-HAP/cutover gates are not fulfilled by this bounded pass. Earlier d435/unmerged792 PORTER notes below retain their historical scope; source1990 and this exact d04 image now have separate accepted normal-exit evidence, not full Runtime acceptance.
<!-- /DM31:A01-RETAINED-IMAGE-RUNTIME:1990 -->

<!-- DM31:G09-FULFILLED:9761 -->
**G09 prerequisite fulfilled (2026-11-07 readback):** [#745 completed scoped CI acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745#issuecomment-6709027699) on merged main `9761dd09a41bbd732085e8bca0e1a556b420ef21`, including actual merged active-caller/report/owned-cleanup adoption. The closed native G09 edge is retained as fulfilled history, not an unresolved blocker. Remaining open native prerequisites: [A09 #759](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759). **This issue remains OPEN** for its own stated acceptance; no production, HAP/device or full-migration result is inferred.
<!-- /DM31:G09-FULFILLED:9761 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-G05`.

**Outcome:** Generic service works without default Core physically installed and packages install without neighboring checkouts or undeclared transitives.

**Owner:** Packaging owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- Not a default-Harness behavior pass
- No dependency upgrades

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `.github/ci-gates.json::gate catalog` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** scripts/ci/verify_server_install.py; tests/architecture/test_dependency_origins.py; tests/server/st/test_replacement_no_core.py (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [.github/ci-gates.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/ci-gates.json) — `gate catalog`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [tests/server/st/test_harness_loading.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/tests/server/st/test_harness_loading.py) — `HarnessLoadingST; IndependentHarnessFactory`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/harness/plugin.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/harness/plugin.py) — `OpenJiuwenFactory`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/deploy/Dockerfile](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/deploy/Dockerfile) — `dependency installation`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Pinned provider identities and exact recovery binding semantics

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Production imports of tests/fakes/reference snapshot/neighbor paths
- Generic dependencies on default-provider commands

**Writable boundary:**
- scripts/ci/verify_server_install.py
- tests/architecture/test_dependency_origins.py
- tests/server/st/test_replacement_no_core.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/820)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/760), [DM31-A21](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/761), [DM31-M01](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/762), [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Independent Harness passes with Core absent, not merely an import blocker
- Missing bound provider fails explicitly instead of fallback
- Clean isolated install and pip check succeed; neighbor PYTHONPATH disabled
- Production-test and undeclared dependency fixtures fail

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite replacement-no-core --require-tests --fail-on-skip

**Assertions:** - server-tests.py --suite replacement-no-core --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)
- server-tests.py --suite clean-install --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** isolated-package-environment, approved-dependency-locks. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR05, AR07.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

<!-- DM31:CURRENT-STATUS:768 -->
#### 当前实施与验证

G05 **OPEN**。实际 `d1fb236d` 的 History Recovery 0.2.0 在 HK 自有 Linux/x86_64 账户按锁定依赖安装，验证 13 wheel 成员、10 模块来源、25/25 实际 UDS/authority/contracts owner 测试；包指纹见原回执。 该隔离叶环境未装 Core。完整 no-Core Runtime、受保护 collector、部署尚未验收。[包和参与者范围](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/768#issuecomment-6878542263)。

追加实际 `629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 的 HK 自有隔离环境局部安装。591 个精确源码、7 个锁定构建工具，实际构建 Contracts/History/Bridge（35/13/545 wheel 成员），连同 vendored Mandate 用 `--no-deps` 安装到 clean site。移走 checkout 后九个 installed origins 和 Registry/Backend/Host 定向 **9/9**；这一环境中 Core/WorkSwarm 物理缺席，实际 factory/model 执行按 fixture 控制。 原包的绝对 Mandate file URI 在源位置移除后仍拒绝同哈希替代路径，当前 partial `pip check` **FAIL**（22 个不同缺依赖），`clean-install` 与 `replacement-no-core` 仍 NOT_ENROLLED。完整依赖、实际 A09 Runtime/独立 Harness 替代、保护安装/collector 和授权测试部署仍待。[#759](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759)。回执 SHA-256 `2db5fa0281e965f95e31514d32c6c48751027d589983a77067eb6f3bb8d4f991`。

实际 `629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 的依赖锁核对已有独立源码复核。HK partial `pip check` 的 22 个普通要求中，G09 约束覆盖 16/22 名称，构建工具 lock 覆盖 0/22；开发清单含 Core，并固定 `portalocker==4.4.0`，不符合实际 Bridge 和 WorkSwarm 的 `<4`。 两个导入的上游 lock 分别覆盖 17/22 和 16/22，并记录同一 `portalocker 3.2.0` wheel 哈希。可选 `[geo]` 的 `maxminddb` 不在五份输入内，单独 NOT_RUN。 依赖全闭包仍缺当前平台及内容哈希。Packaging、Bridge 与 WorkSwarm owner 对齐实际约束及受审输入后重跑隔离 clean `pip check`、原 no-Core/replacement Harness；本次无下载、升级或运行结果变更。回执 SHA-256 `b21817041c1edd741d219d011908cca76525655c9d3d21defeda36b21dde237a`。

另一个有界安装回执 [#1720 `601f3c9d507081640acb799480c1d873b546b8b8`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1720) 独审核 HK 三本地 wheel 及私有 History 10/13/16 源/wheel/安装，实际 reader origin 与配置依赖反例通过。117 声明只枚举。[#1014](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1014) 记录限定 pip 条件。原完整锁、`pip check`、no-Core/独立 Harness 与实际 TEST 结论保持。回执 `855f758efd1a955840a2540b0e6e66c36cc698cbd75f7194ea23e109a0c5fcba`。

**现行移动源码的局部安装。** 实际 `09489ca8a3b52ecd68da9076cee08bb1e8bee9d1` 588 scoped source paths 与相关 629 字节/模式相同。自有 HK 干净 venv 用锁定工具从移动后三个真实源码根按 Docker 的相对顺序执行 `pip --no-index --no-build-isolation --no-deps`。Bridge 真实 metadata 生成移动后 Mandate URI，第二次 pip 按该 URI 安装相同 vendored hash，21 条 payload RECORD 与四个来源核对通过，来源验证前已删 staging。 旧 629 prebuilt wheel 指向删除后的旧 URI FAIL 保留。独立复核通过该源码阶段；partial `pip check` 仍 FAIL（22 种依赖缺失），[geo]、完整 Runtime/独立 Harness、protected/full/collector/Docker/TEST 均未运行。回执 SHA-256 `502f95641a6d61a8edf65de4919455c1eb4e949af57e47cd2f1bd4b73af1a6d8`。

<!-- DM31:G09-FULFILLED:9761 -->
**G09 prerequisite fulfilled (2026-11-07 readback):** [#745 completed scoped CI acceptance](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745#issuecomment-6709027699) on merged main `9761dd09a41bbd732085e8bca0e1a556b420ef21`, including actual merged active-caller/report/owned-cleanup adoption.
